Deleted rather than replaced: the card's own body already lists what the report contains (הערכת שווי, ציון כדאיות, תובנות), so the title only has to name the step.

seo_decision.flagged_by: the previous round, which stopped short of touching these two and said the decision had to be made first
rationale: The only token removed is the adjective חכם. It is not a query anyone types next to נדלן, so nothing that ranks is being given up.
The <title> gains מנתוני ממשלה in its place — a phrase that is both a real query and a claim the product meets, so the title is not merely shorter.
The description keeps the unpointed spelling נדלן, which is a common search variant; the title carries the pointed spelling נדל"ן. Both variants stay covered across the two tags.
seo_decision.not_claimed: That ranking will improve, or that it will not move. No rank measurement was taken before or after, and none is being inferred.
